❌ Legacy Multimodal SDP Content/Label Failure Modes (RFC 4796/4574)
1. Screen-Share Audio S2S Prompt Injection: Shared tab audio (a=content:slides)
mixed into primary caller voice (main) triggers unauthorized S2S tool calls.
2. Duplicate RFC 4574 a=label Collision: Two m= lines share the same
a=label token -> SIPREC compliance recorder archives a silent dummy track.
3. Sign-Language (a=content:sl) Starvation: Congestion controller drops
sign-language video to 3 fps, breaking deaf/hard-of-hearing intelligibility.
Result: Screen-audio S2S hijack + SIPREC track overwrite + sl starvation
✅ Deterministic P999–P1000 🎉 Content Isolation & Label Gate
1. P999 (1,008th Guard) Content Role Isolation: Block a=content:slides/alt
from S2S command reasoning & lock a=content:main audio tracks to [1, 1].
2. P1000 🎉 (🎉 Historic P1000 Guardrail!) Label Uniqueness & sl Floor:
Enforce 100% unique a=label tokens & clamp a=content:sl in [15, 30] fps.
3. ADA / EN 301 549 Accessibility Compliance: Shed auxiliary slides/speaker
bitrate first so sign-language interpretation remains smooth under loss.
Result: 0 slides-to-main hijacks · 0 label collisions · sl ∈ [15, 30] fps
